card.name: Just before "usual" or "ordinarily"
card.fires_on: The spot right before the word "usual", "ordinarily" or "normal" is expected, often as the first piece of Usual or Ordinarily. Mostly in dosage tables and dosing text.

modes.label: Usual dosage table
modes.description: Start of "Usual" in a renal-impairment dosing table header.
modes.example: Dose Frequency > 30<< Us>>ual Recommended Dosage* Every 1

modes.label: Ordinarily after dose advice
modes.description: Start of "Ordinarily" at the beginning of a sentence after titration instructions.
modes.example: to achieve optimal clinical response.<< Ord>>inarily, optimal clinical response is achieved

modes.label: Before usual or normal in prose
modes.description: Words just before "usual" or "normal" in running text.
modes.example: left to pursue<< their>> usual occupations.

card.writes: It boosts words meaning "commonly" or "commonly used" and suppresses "normal" in several forms.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say "usual" or "ordinarily", as in usual dose wording.
